name: C'tan Shard
equipped_with: A C'tan Shard is equipped with: Fists of a Star God.

weapons.name: Gaze of Death
weapons.abilities: Auto Hit, Blood Drinker, Poison(2+), Suppression(6)

option_groups.header: Only one C'tan Shard per army.
May select up to three of the following upgrades:

choices.name: Infinite Recursion
abilities: Infinite Recursion: The model may manifest a power it already used this turn a second time. (Note: Only works together with Cosmic Tyrant)

choices.name: Writhing Worldscape
abilities: Writhing Worldscape: All terrain within 6" of the model is treated as difficult and dangerous terrain for enemy units.

choices.name: Untamed Power
abilities: Untamed Power: The model gains +1 Strength and +1 Attack.

choices.name: Cosmic Tyrant
abilities: Cosmic Tyrant: The model may manifest another power per turn.

choices.name: Dread
abilities: Dread: Enemy units within 12" suffer -2 to their Leadership.

choices.name: Entropic Touch
abilities: Entropic Touch: The model gains the "Shred" ability for all melee attacks.

choices.name: Grand Illusion
abilities: Grand Illusion: At the beginning of the first battle round, you can remove up to three of your units from the field and redeploy them. Alternatively, each unit can also be placed in reserve.

choices.name: Transdimensional Displacement
abilities: Transdimensional Displacement: The model automatically advances 6" instead of rolling for it

choices.name: Gaze of Death
abilities: Gaze of Death: The model gains the "Gaze of Death" weapon.

choices.name: Matter Absorption
abilities: Matter Absorption: The model restores all lost Wounds if it kills a vehicle.

choices.name: Misdirect
abilities: Misdirect: The model gains the "Deflect", "Hit & Run" and "Parry" abilities.

choices.name: Spear of the Dragon
abilities: Spear of the Dragon: The model gains the "Spear of the Dragon" weapon. Replaces "Fists of a Star God".

choices.name: Seismic Assault
abilities: Seismic Assault: The model gains the "Seismic Assault" weapon.

choices.name: Scythe of the Nightbringer
abilities: Scythe of the Nightbringer: The model gains the "Scythe of the Nightbringer" weapon. Replaces "Fists of a Star God".

choices.name: Sentient Necrodermis
abilities: Sentient Necrodermis: The model gains the "Regeneration(2)" ability.

choices.name: Voltaic Storm
abilities: Voltaic Storm: The model gains the "Voltaic Storm" weapon.

choices.name: Hardened Necrodermis
abilities: Hardened Necrodermis: The model gains a 3+ armor save.
Anti-Grav, Mindless, Regeneration(1), Terrifying(-1)

Immune to Natural Law: When moving, this model treats all other models and terrain as open ground, allowing it to move freely over them. It automatically passes all dangerous terrain tests. However, it cannot end its move on top of another model and may only end its move on impassable terrain if the model can physically be placed there.
Necrodermis: The model gains Ward(4+) If it loses its last wound, it explodes like a vehicle with Strength 7 and AP -1.
Powers of the C'tan: The model can manifest 1 power per turn automatically. It knows all powers from the list of C'tan powers. A C'tan can only use each power once per battle round.
